ft84ScopedCompletion.completeSelectedWording:
FT84-Q02 / FT84-RESEARCH-PHASES-01 — two named research-process completions, not a universal research clock.
KEEP each actual more-specific project phase, completion check, loss, source access, material rule and fixed waiting period. Language training already uses completed fifteen-active-minute phases; Ritual Caster already names that study clock; advanced manufacture already has its included first min(15, adjusted total minutes) incorporation and declared later phases of at most eight hours. Those are distinct procedures. Diligent Researcher halves only authorized ordinary active research using actually relevant library/archive/facility access. It does not shorten teaching, language courses, copying, ritual learning/execution, item encoding, Scribing Insight gain or its specific spend route, repair or independently elapsed waits.
NEW NARROW COMPLETION applies only where no more-specific phase is supplied for (A) LA-07's ordinary preregistered Translate/Decipher project of at most 250 words, and (B) the Crafting/Harvest framework's research of an existing available formula. For these two named processes, establish the full baseline active requirement first: 480 minutes for A; 60*max(8, actual minimumResearchHours) for B. Then take the strongest actually applicable research-time factor once. Required time is tracked in active seconds, rounded upward only once if the final exact requirement contains a fractional second; this is local project precision, not a new global simulation tick.
For these processes alone, credit completed fifteen-active-minute research phases and one final shorter phase exactly equal to the remaining requirement. This final remainder can arise from the actual adjusted requirement or an actual authorized progress loss; do not pad it to fifteen minutes or truncate it. This is expressly NEW for A/B; matching the teaching quantum is a selected convention, not evidence that teaching governed research already. A phase boundary is bookkeeping, not an interruption of real continuous work. A real interruption or lost prerequisite loses only that phase's unfinished prospective credit; completed credit, actual elapsed work, paid access, used stock and genuine losses persist. No resource incorporation/stabilization occurs merely because a research phase completes. Work can stop safely at completed boundaries with secure real notes; a new session continues the same project and evidence identity.
Maintain separate ledgers for actual work, credited research, uncredited/lost work, stock, fees, fixed waits, participating actors, evidence/method and final check. No minute also funds another project, training, guarding or rest; at most two actual active work Watches remain. LA-07's one qualified assistant earns its +1 only by materially attending all adjusted required work, including the successful replacement of interrupted phases; pay actual agreed attendance/access, not a free assumed assistant. Recipe creation assistant caps do not automatically become formula-research permissions. A formula-research case with no independently supported assistant uses none. One declared lead check is made at real completion under its original skill/DC and task degrees. Success yields only the supported passage/formula; failure yields notes under that source. No intermediate phase roll, extra result, XP, material salvage or repeated unchanged-evidence roll is created. Retry prerequisites, concrete changed-method work and original information/public-private limits remain. Other research sources need their own actual clock; this completion does not assign them A/B's phases.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Starting grants versus population descriptions
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: KEEP exact grants; resolve descriptive-table conflicts
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
An ancestry's actual Languages trait grants the languages it names. A descriptive language-table population, culture, occupation or class association grants nothing by itself. Apply the actual base, one actual variant and the actual background; preserve all source text beside the resulting grant record.

Retain these base grants, with their printed speaking/reading/writing:
Amphibian: Common, Aquan; Umbrin: Common, Elvish, Murkish; Drakari: Common, Draconic; Dwarf: Common, Dwarvish; Elf: Common, Elvish; Feykin: Common, Sylvan; Gnome: Common, Gnomish; Goblin: Common, Goblin; Human: Common and one choice; Mycelian: Common and one language common in its home region; Ogre: Common, Giant; Orc: Common, Orc; Troll: Common, Giant; Undead: Common and one choice.

Troll therefore retains Giant. Trollish remains a distinct attested identity, not a replacement or additional Troll grant. Mycelian retains its regional choice, not automatic Mycelic/Sporetongue and not the abbreviated runtime's fixed “Mycelian.” Mycelic can satisfy that choice when it actually qualifies as common in the chosen home region. A Deep Dwarf retains Dwarvish/Common, without an additional Murkish grant. An Umbrin already has Murkish explicitly. A Storm Druid gains no Primordial merely from the population description.

The chapter's descriptive language groupings are not exclusive access ranks. Draconic occurs in its ordinary population table and as an Exotic example in the introduction. Preserve both labels and its single identity; an actual fixed grant remains valid under either description. LA-05 supplies finite choice eligibility instead of silently correcting the book.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes: Mira's Battlefield Medic background supplies no language. Her Common and selected Dwarvish remain the actual Human grant, unchanged by this conference or the fulfilled teaching review. A Troll who has no other language grant begins with Common/Giant, not Common/Trollish/Giant.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Canonical identities, aliases and dialect scope
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: KEEP explicit aliases; NEW bounded canonical and dialect policy
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
Preserve source spelling; store a separate canonical identity. Adopt exactly these mechanical aliases: Orc/Orcish → `orcish`; Mycelic/Sporetongue → `mycelic`. Exercise the book's explicit option to combine Imperial's Westreach, Eastern Sigil and Northern Vale under `common` mechanically; retain the named cultural/register variant. These Common variants do not consume additional language choices or automatically defeat difficult handwriting, a cipher or an unknown cultural allusion.

Do not alias the runtime label “Mycelian” to Mycelic: the current exact grant is a regional choice. Record the legacy value and an unresolved choice requiring a real selection, not an invented past choice. No other fuzzy, substring, creature-name or translation-based alias is authorized.

Trollish and Giant are separate competencies: “dialect” in the Trollish description does not name a parent language. Deep Cant, Deep Speech, Murkish, Forgotten Script, Runic and Resonant Cant remain six distinct literal identities. Shared script, an ancient label or a similar use does not merge them.

NEW Primordial dialect completion: keep `primordial` as the general named language and register Auran, Aquan, Ignan and Terran as related but independently known competencies. Relatedness alone supplies no automatic mutual comprehension or four-for-one grant. The already attested Aquan is the same `aquan` identity used by Amphibian; do not create a second “elemental Aquan.”

Elemental-Touched grants one choice: general Primordial, or the dialect of the already selected elemental affinity. NEW explicit affinity map: air→Auran, water→Aquan, fire→Ignan, earth→Terran. Retain the original Primordial parent-label and the selected option in provenance. Choosing the dialect fulfills that one grant; it does not also grant general Primordial or the other dialects. Other sources simply granting Primordial grant general Primordial unless they actually offer this dialect choice. This is a mechanical interpretation, not a ruling about elemental origins.

Unspecified pronunciations, written forms or deep-language relationships remain unspecified. A canonical ID identifies the literal source label; it is not evidence that a universal dictionary, historical origin or translation exists.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes: An Orc's “Orc” and a later reference to “Orcish” are one language. An Amphibian choosing the water-affinity Aquan option obtains no second Aquan; the still-open Elemental-Touched option may instead be general Primordial. A general-Primordial speaker does not automatically understand an Aquan sentence under this NEW dialect policy.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: All forty-five variants
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: KEEP base plus literal variant additions
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
Apply all fourteen base Languages traits unchanged. Of the forty-five variants, only High Elf's `high-elf--extra-language` adds one language and Imperial Human's `imperial-human--diplomatic-training` adds one language. Both are additions, not replacements. The other forty-three variants make no direct language-grant change.

Record variant spell, animal-communication and empathic traits in their own capability channels, not as additional languages. In particular, Cavern Mystic's fungi-only Speak with Plants, Arcanist Gnome's Speak with Small Beasts and Shaman Orc's Speak with Animals are not Murkish, animal-language fluency or Primordial grants. Their actual procedures and access remain LA-10. Symbiotic Empathic Link conveys only its actual bounded information; “link” does not teach a language.

The full forty-five-ID register accompanies this verdict. No source alternative or abbreviated builder record takes precedence over the reviewed full base/variant package.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes: Imperial Human has Common, the Human choice and the separate Diplomatic Training choice. With Seeker of the Lost Pantheon's two choices, there are four choice slots plus Common, resolved under their real restrictions. Deep Dwarf does not acquire Murkish from a table describing some Deep Dwarves as speakers.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Speaking, literacy and script knowledge
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: KEEP explicit modes; NEW missing-mode completion
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
Record separately: receptive spoken comprehension; ability to formulate/speak that language; reading; writing; and familiarity with an identified script/orthography. Current hearing, sight, voice and manipulating capacity determine whether that knowledge can be used now; inability to use a channel does not erase the knowledge.

NEW default for a permanent ordinary language grant stated simply as “know,” “one language” or a background language row: it grants spoken comprehension, speaking, reading and writing in that language's ordinary attested written form, unless that source expressly narrows the modes. This completes the fifteen background fields and Imperial Human's shorthand consistently with the explicit base/High-Elf traits. It does not apply to a temporary “understand,” “communicate,” “basic ideas,” “fragmentary script” or research-progress effect. Those retain only their printed or separately completed modes.

Knowing a written language entails familiarity with the script actually used to read/write it. Gnomish and Orcish use the Dwarvish script as their source traits state. Recognizing those characters does not supply Dwarvish, Gnomish or Orcish vocabulary, grammar, fluency, cultural context or arbitrary codes. Other alphabet relationships are not inferred. Where no named script is supplied, use a language-local orthography identifier for bookkeeping; do not invent a lore name or assert an unrelated shared alphabet.

NEW script-only completion: selecting a specifically written/script-based competency provides reading/writing of its actually established conventional content, not a free oral mode. Runic's attested scope is script-based. Forgotten Script must be bound to the particular admitted written tradition, not “all forgotten writing.” Their spoken forms remain unspecified, not declared nonexistent. Knowing a script alone grants character recognition/copying, not an unknown language's meanings. A physical facsimile of writing is not an understood translation or a successfully encoded spell.

A “speak/read/write” knowledge grant does not generate missing vocal anatomy, sensory organs, a pheromone emitter, hands or a magical channel. Preserve the Mycelic description without authoring its biology here. Actual writing must be perceptible through a supported method: an ordinary flat ink inscription does not become tactile-readable by assertion. An explicit spell's touch-reading permission is a different source exception.

Temporary comprehension ends on its actual expiration/suppression conditions. A remembered specific message or a genuinely made translation remains ordinary acquired information; no general language or magical function persists merely because it was once understood.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes: An Orcish-literate reader recognizes Dwarvish-script letters in Gnomish, but cannot translate the sentence without Gnomish competence, real evidence or a qualifying effect. A background's one named ordinary language includes literacy under this NEW completion. Comprehend Languages still grants neither speaking nor writing proficiency.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Choice slots, duplicate grants and availability
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: KEEP source restrictions; NEW language-specific duplicate procedure
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
Resolve fixed grants first, then language choice slots in a recorded order. Combine duplicate fixed competencies by union of actually granted modes and retain every provenance record. A duplicate fixed language gives no substitute language, Expertise, bonus, feat, training credit or future banked choice unless its source expressly supplies a replacement.

NEW: an unspent language-choice slot can select another not-already-satisfied eligible competency within that slot's actual restriction. Two language choices mean two distinct eligible choices, not two copies of Common. A later choice may add genuinely missing modes of a known competency; it still grants only what its source permits and creates no extra refund. A resolved historical choice is not freely respecifiable at each rest. Correct an actual invalid/duplicate choice at creation or an evidenced data-reconciliation event, preserving the original record. When no eligible unsatisfied option exists, record the slot as exhausted with no added benefit; do not block character creation or bank a secret future tongue.

Unrestricted choices can use the book's named ordinary population-language identities where the character's upbringing/contact supports them. Exotic or other cultural options need an actual allowed grant/contact. The chapter supports Abyssal, Celestial and Draconic as Exotic examples; Infernal and Primordial are also admitted NEW ordinary Exotic choice options where the source allows an open Exotic choice. None of these category tags themselves creates a teacher, setting membership or access to a protected text.

Closed source alternatives remain closed. Rift-Scarred Survivor chooses exactly one of Abyssal/Celestial/Primordial/Deep Cant. Wildling Herbalist chooses Sylvan or Primordial. Marked Fugitive's “e.g.” and the Cult/Corruption Survivor “often” examples are illustrative within their obscure/factional or Exotic restriction, not an unrestricted secret-language menu. Mycelian's choice needs a stated home region where that language is actually common. Elemental-Touched uses LA-02. Celestial Emissary's Celestial is fixed.

The Director establishes the available player-safe choice list and its ordinary upbringing/contact premise before selection. An explicit named starting grant needs no retroactive paid course, and an explicitly offered Deep Cant choice is not deleted merely because its origins remain deferred. Conversely, “one of your choice” cannot bypass an actual attunement, secret-source or class-only restriction. The Voice and Resonant Cant receive no ordinary choice entitlement here.

Only fifteen of the twenty backgrounds have a Languages field. Aethel City Guard Veteran, Expedition Cartographer, Battlefield Medic, Frontier Settler and Underworld Escapee add no language through an absent field. Absence remains absence in the source, not a null replacement or an instruction to erase ancestry languages.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes: A fixed Celestial grant received twice produces one Celestial competency with two sources and no free Abyssal. A still-open unrestricted choice may instead choose a different eligible language. A Mycelian regional choice cannot be resolved as an unknown private language simply because a UI exposes its name.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Ordinary learning with finite work and costs
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: NEW ordinary course; KEEP work and source-specific restrictions
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
No complete controlling ordinary fluency course was located in the supplied language evidence and current governing procedures. The bounded training search does not prove none exists in all historical project files. Adopt this NEW course for the candidate; these are game-authoring values, not claimed real-world acquisition rates.

A course names one actual language or dialect identity, the modes sought, its script where relevant, the learner, a qualified instructor or a complete usable curriculum, and legitimate access. An instructor must actually possess the modes being taught and a mutually usable instructional channel. Self-study requires sufficient authentic explanations, examples, exercises and a means of checking their meaning; a bare unknown inscription, an isolated translation, a price or a Language Insight balance is not a full curriculum. Spoken production requires actual means of practicing/receiving correction; a comprehension-only effect does not supply that ability.

NEW modules:
• Spoken comprehension and production of one language: 240 active hours.
• Literacy for a semantically known language in one written form: 80 active hours, comprising 40 of script/orthographic familiarity plus 40 of language-specific reading/writing practice.
• Script familiarity alone: 40 active hours, with no semantic fluency.
• A complete new ordinary spoken-and-literate language therefore requires 320 active hours. Prior genuine familiarity with its very same script satisfies only the forty-hour script module, reducing that complete course to 280 hours; it does not shorten the 240-hour language module.
• For an admitted written-only language, use 240 hours of its written-language semantics plus the same 80-hour orthographic/literacy module. It grants the attested written modes, not speech. Learning another dialect has no automatic related-language discount.

A source explicitly granting modes bypasses training only for those modes. Do not retroactively charge starting grants or newly impose training on existing lawful knowledge. Partial study can support specifically recorded learned words/cues as evidence; it does not satisfy a feature requiring knowledge of the language. No numerical language skill, PB increase or Expertise is created.

Credit completed fifteen-active-minute teaching/practice phases, with a final shorter phase only when needed to finish a module after a real source-specific loss/adjustment. Interruption loses the unfinished phase's prospective credit, not previously completed phases; real elapsed time, spent materials and fees remain. Resume from the same course ledger after actual prerequisites return. A missing teacher/channel, inaudible lesson, unavailable curriculum or contrary condition provides no progress. Administrative phase boundaries are not breaks in actual concentration. Apply an actual Oracle Tongues loss of ten minutes to the real credited progress; do not waive it by splitting the log.

NEW ordinary one-to-one instruction reference: 1 gp per eight actual instruction hours, including ordinary lesson consumables that the provider actually supplies. A named real quote or voluntary tutor can differ; neither quoted money nor ownership conjures the instructor, books, rare texts, copying rights or equipment. Self-study has no invented tutor fee, but requires actual curriculum/materials. Pay for actual instruction, including time that a real interruption or condition made unproductive; unused prepaid hours remain only under the actual agreement. Round the final purchase once upward to copper. No automatic refund, resale value or teacher availability is promised.

Training uses actual minutes within the existing eight-hour Watch and two-active-work-Watch ceiling, subject to the separately governing rest/Strain/access rules. No minute also funds guarding, travel, beneficial rest, crafting, another course, formula research, Insight gain or Insight expenditure unless an explicit actual rule allows concurrent work. Teaching also occupies the tutor's real work time. No calendar-day conversion, sleep shortcut, INT/PB discount, artisan creation benefit or pending feat applies.

Completion is deterministic when all required module hours, actual mode prerequisites and final authentic practice are recorded. Final practice occupies the last required phase; it adds no unbounded examination hours or separate completion fee. No last-minute random fluency check or extra failure fee is introduced. Complete precisely those modes; grant no trade XP, formula, spell, rank, faction permission or other language. Research, deciphering and temporary magical comprehension do not substitute for hours or modules.

Keep Quick Learner's pending thirty-day/once-per-category text in its feat queue; it is neither the origin of these hours nor an active course discount.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes: An Orcish-literate learner already knows the Dwarvish script. Learning spoken and written Gnomish costs 240+40=280 active hours, reference tutor fee35gp, not zero because the letters look familiar. A learner starting with no matching script needs320hours/40gp at that reference. A 40-minute session interrupted in its third15-minute phase gives30minutes course credit but40minutes actual time; its single reference invoice is ceiling(40/60×100/8)=9cp. An applicable failed Tongues save later removes ten minutes of real progress; logging four fifteen-minute phases never pretends an uninterrupted session was broken.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Understanding, translation, deciphering and research
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: NEW bounded ordinary information procedures; KEEP specific routes
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
Ordinary comprehensible speech or plain text in a known language needs no check merely to understand it. Hearing/reading access, technical vocabulary, actual ambiguity, a separate code and the truth of a claim remain separate questions. Script recognition is not semantic understanding. Fluency does not itself identify magic, authenticate a speaker, detect a lie or supply lost facts.

NEW routine written translation: a capable reader of the source language who can write the destination language may translate accessible plain noncoded prose, using actual writing tools and stock, without a roll. Allow ten active minutes per250words, proportionately rounded up to a whole minute, minimum one. This is an ordinary-prose reference, not a new speed for copying/encoding formulas, magical payloads or authenticating contracts. A transcription in the same script can preserve characters without understanding them and receives no translation status.

NEW one-minute recognition task, only when uncertain and evidence-bearing: INT(History), DC10 for a familiar attested script/style, DC15 for a plausibly related attested dialect/script, DC20 for a damaged/obscured but still diagnostic specimen. Use the existing one applicable PB contribution and Core degrees. Success identifies only the supported identity/relationship; Critical Success may disambiguate supported evidence, not reveal a translation. If the specimen cannot support identification, there is no informational roll that invents it. Routine obvious recognition by a competent reader needs none.

NEW ordinary Translate/Decipher project: preregister one actual passage of at most250words, its real source meaning or finite supported meaning, the relevant bilingual/parallel/grammatical/key evidence, method, output language and potential missing sections. Spend eight active hours. For linguistic reconstruction use INT(History): DC15 for supported related-dialect reconstruction, DC20 for unfamiliar but adequately evidenced language, DC25 for damaged yet recoverable correspondence. For a separate mundane cipher, use INT(Investigation) with actual cipher evidence: DC15 for an adequate known key, DC20 for sufficiently constrained ordinary cipher analysis, DC25 for a difficult but genuinely solvable damaged/incomplete key. A plainly usable key may remove uncertainty entirely; no task manufactures the underlying language.

Declare the applicable DC and one lead ability/skill before work. Do not stack several proficiencies for several relevant disciplines. One qualified assistant may give +1 by performing all eight hours with a real useful method/channel; this NEW assistant applies only to this new ordinary project. It does not add assistants to courses, preservation, dismantling or a different source procedure.

Success yields only the preregistered supported passage/deciphered layer. Critical Success supplies no second passage, fluency, extra meaning, code bypass, permanent bonus or banked labor. Failure produces notes but no certified translation, consumes the work, and does not fabricate authoritative false lore; Critical Failure has the same informational result, plus only a genuinely predeclared independently lawful hazard, if any. Unsupported or inaccessible meaning makes a project unqualified, not a high-DC invitation to invent a solution. An illegible gap stays a gap.

A fresh check needs genuinely new evidence or eight additional hours of a concretely different supported method. Repeated rolling, a different reader holding the same unsupported page or reformatting the text supplies no new source meaning. Information found can become genuine evidence for a later project, but hours/rewards are not duplicated.

Keep formula research/copying at its own exact trade gates, DC, max(8, source minimumResearchHours), and one-hour/1sp copying rule. Keep Scribing Insight expenditure in LA-14 as a distinct supported-passage route without adding this new decipher check to it. Keep legitimate Seeker, Cult and Relic information features within their actual subject scopes; they do not create translation powers. Pending Polyglot/Diligent Researcher grant no modifier/time reduction yet.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes: A reader can copy Dwarvish-script Gnomish characters without knowing Gnomish, but cannot call that a translation. Eight hours and a high History roll cannot recover a destroyed sentence for which no source meaning survives. Three genuine Scribing Insight plus its own eight hours can translate its supported passage without also completing eight course hours or gaining another Insight.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Speech, signs and interpretation in real time
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: KEEP brief communication; NEW finite scheduling and signals
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
Keep the normal six-second round and the rule that brief communication is not an additional Action. It is not free movement, a free feature activation, an extra Reaction or authority to interrupt a resolved event.

NEW finite scheduling: a creature's aggregate free ordinary speech/signing during one numbered round must fit at most six seconds of actual brief delivery. Count warnings/replies as part of that allowance, not a refresh on every interlocutor or extra turn. Outside initiative, use actual elapsed conversational time. This allowance never shortens another required action, permits overlapping incompatible vocal tasks or substitutes for the Action/Bonus Action/Reaction of an actual feature. A spell's own words are governed by its casting procedure, not a bonus ordinary utterance or a new universal word cap.

A longer deliberate exchange uses actual time and, in initiative, an Action for each additional six-second segment on a turn when that Action is available. Off-turn lengthy delivery needs an actual applicable permission such as a legitimately readied communication Action, or waits; a brief warning cannot stop someone else's completed attack. Apply silence, consciousness, speech, hands and other actual restrictions. Surprise alone retains its printed brief-communication permission; it does not grant the unavailable Action.

Interpretation requires the interpreter actually perceive and understand the incoming content and produce an outgoing form the recipient actually understands/perceives. A translator's fluency is not lent to the recipient. Receiving, translating and relaying must occur in that order. A short source phrase and equally brief rendition may fit the available interval; a long statement or multi-hop relay cannot be compressed into one instant. Record when the destination meaning arrives. After a check/effect has resolved, late interpretation does not retroactively qualify a hearing/understanding trigger. No default interpreter bonus or magical mental link is granted.

NEW ordinary party-signal procedure: ten active minutes of actual mutual demonstration/rehearsal may establish up to six fixed simple cues, recorded with meanings and participants. For example: halt, approach, retreat, danger, left and right. No new fluent sign language, arbitrary sentence encoding, universal cultural meaning or secret-codebreaking skill follows. A one-hand cue needs that usable hand and a receiver who can actually see its motion; a documented two-hand cue needs both. Distance, cover, light and attention must make the actual cue perceptible; no universal sight/hearing radius is invented. Complex formal sign languages require an actual source/course, not six cues renamed as fluency.

Accessible player communication at the table is not a fictional speech, gesture, V component or oath violation. Apply the character's actual declared action and capacity without demanding that the player perform the voice or signs. Fictional inability to speak does not prevent a player from privately explaining an intended action.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes: Two allied interpreters cannot relay a thirty-second explanation through a chain before an attack already resolving. A Deafened character who sees the rehearsed retreat cue can understand that cue; it does not satisfy an ability requiring the character to hear the bard. Message's one-Action brief message retains its own existing bound, not a newly imported25-word limit.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Hearing, silence and actual components
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: KEEP native conditions; NEW explicit ordinary-channel completion
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
Deafened prevents hearing and hearing-dependent reception; it does not erase language knowledge, bar reading/signs/eligible telepathy, or by itself prevent speaking and supplying one's own V component. A hearing-dependent instruction, warning or performance cannot qualify merely because the creature knows the language.

Silenced prevents verbal components, command words, Chants and audible coordination as printed. NEW explicit ordinary-channel wording: this includes intentionally spoken ordinary messages; it does not prohibit thought or every nonvocal channel. A Silenced creature may read, write, sign or use an independently valid mental effect if its actual condition and physical state permit. Silenced is not automatically Deafened, sound deletion throughout an area, sonic-damage immunity or universal incapacity.

V requires the caster's actual audible speech. Ordinary translation, lipreading, recorded speech, another creature speaking, a signed message, a telepathic phrase or a voice-mimicking device does not provide that caster's V. S/F/material/access requirements remain their own procedures. A language grant never grants spell repertoire, components, a formula, RP or casting permission. An explicit actual class no-component or in-form exception retains only its exact scope.

Track each restricting effect separately with source, actual forbidden operations/recipients and duration. An operation is unavailable while any applicable prohibition remains. Removing one silence source does not remove another; identical prohibitions are not additive penalties or a longer stacked duration. A condition label alone does not rewrite a narrower effect.

Keep the combat action Silence the Caster narrower: it prevents verbal-component Reactions through its printed window, not ordinary speech or Action-time verbal casting, and uses its actual single concentration check. Keep generic concentration independent of silence unless sustaining that actual effect requires audible performance or another governing interruption applies. Bard audible performance and its rhythm rules have their express stricter behavior. Physical acoustic suppression and an actor-specific verbal prohibition are distinct records.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes: A Deafened caster with usable voice/hands/focus can cast an otherwise legal V spell; a Silenced caster cannot supply V merely by telepathically saying its words. An enemy affected only by Null Command Aura may still speak ordinarily. A Silence the Caster hit does not suppress the target's next legal Action-time V spell.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Reviewed ordinary spells and ancestry communication
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: KEEP current operative procedures; distinguish transient meaning from competence
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
Keep all eight selected current operative records at their actual class/rank access, components, costs, targets and duration. No source-to-operational conflict is reopened here.

Comprehend Languages: Action, V/S/F, Self, ordinary speech actually heard and writing clearly seen or touched within30ft, concentration up to10minutes. It supplies literal semantic understanding only. Keep its explicit exclusions for codes/ciphers/secret cant, intentionally obscured wording, magical glyph functions, command words, untranslatable proper names, nonliteral cultural subtext and protected information. It grants no speaking/writing competency, universal script familiarity or hidden meaning. Its existing concentration duration, rather than an older instantaneous source field, remains controlling.

Message: Action, V/S, one perceived recipient within120ft and its actual line/cover restrictions, one brief message deliverable in that Action. No automatic reply, recipient language comprehension, mind-reading, identity authentication, planar contact or total-cover bypass. Knowing the destination's language is useful but does not erase Deafened or sound/communication restrictions. Do not restore an obsolete25-word proposal.

Speak with Dead: keep the actual sixty-foot line-of-effect/remains procedure, Action/V/S/F, up to one minute/five exchanges and no concentration. The casting Action includes no question. Each materially unified inquiry and answer costs its own Action/about six seconds and one allowance, including unknown or uncomprehended attempts. The echo answers audibly in a language actually known to the deceased, from recorded memories/beliefs, not objective omniscience or automatic translation. Interpreting still requires a real available channel and time; it does not make the echo understand a language it did not know. Preserve the exact original expiration marker through initiative changes. The distinct Lesser/Death Whisper records remain pending LA-11.

Omen Whisper: preserve the one actually supported usable clue that only the caster perceives and understands, with its fixed subject/repetition limits. No new language, identified speaker or setting explanation is derived from “whisper.” Calm Whispers retains its actual hearing target and native failed-save attack rider, not a new shared-language requirement. Resonance Whisper retains the actual Guide/Disturb task-check riders and source duration, not a communication proficiency. Soundburst retains its actual damage/save and native Deafened duration; no invented global hearing/alarm radius. Silent Image is a static visual illusion with no sound; depicted script does not become true translation, authenticated evidence or a functional magical inscription.

Keep the ancestry-only spell identities separate from ordinary class spell access. Cavern Mystic's WIS Speak with Plants is the actual one-long-rest, character-level1, fungi-only grant: Action V/S, ten minutes, no concentration, local plants within30ft, simple supported impressions from the preceding24hours, no remote network, control or guaranteed unknown answer. Shaman Orc's WIS Speak with Animals begins at character level3 and retains its source one/day recharge, not an invented long-rest substitution: Action V/S, ten minutes/no concentration, Beasts in actual auditory range that hear, basic ideas within actual experience/intelligence, normal agency. Preserve their actual source casting route rather than adding ordinary RP/class access by analogy.

Arcanist Gnome's sounds-and-gestures communication with Small-or-smaller beasts remains basic ideas, not a new fluent language or permission to omit whichever physical communication is actually necessary. Genuine outcomes can be remembered or written down. When a magical communication/comprehension ends, its transient capability ends; real information already learned remains bounded information, not general language or spell knowledge.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes: A speaker hearing a foreign sentence under Comprehend Languages may remember its supported translation, but cannot subsequently improvise a fluent reply in that language. A Message in unknown Orcish stays unintelligible to an unassisted non-Orcish recipient. A corpse's sincerely mistaken memory remains mistaken even when translated accurately. The ancestry fungi conversation grants no plant-control instruction.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Fifteen pending ordinary-spell routes
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: KEEP pending; no new spell approval or imported implementation
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
Retain every complete original, current access/rank and operational:null distinction. The fifteen existing dedicated questions remain the only pending spell-effect work required by this conference:

silent-echo→IL-02; silence→IL-26; magic-thread→UN-16; magic-mouth→UN-23; whispers-from-beyond→NE-04; death-whisper→NE-08; speak-with-dead-lesser→NE-22; blindness-deafness→NE-29; awaken→TR5-05; concordant-mindlink→UN5-06; absolute-silence→EV8-03; mental-collapse→DE8-11; feeblemind→DE8-13; telepathy→TU8-11; perfect-mesmerize→EN9-07.

Use their exact preparation paths and full questions in PENDING_LANGUAGE_INTERFACES.json. Silent Echo/Magic Mouth need their actual recording/trigger, voice, limit and replay procedures; neither grants authentic identity, fluency or the caster's V. Magic Thread needs its actual stored effect and finite word/touch trigger rules. Awaken needs its actual target, language and agency profile, not automatic obedience. Telepathy/Concordant Mindlink need their own recipients, consent, range, duration, direction and semantic scope; Oracle Echo Voice supplies none of those missing spell values.

Silence and Absolute Silence are not interchangeable. Preserve Absolute Silence's actual no-sound wording and doubled-thunder-spell source issue for EV8-03, rather than importing ordinary Silence or thunder immunity. Mental Collapse/Feeblemind's broader communication prohibitions require their own final modes/duration/restoration, not automatic equivalence to Silenced. Preserve Perfect Mesmerize's exact pending duration/condition questions. Do not merge any Lesser/Death Whisper with reviewed Speak with Dead.

These fifteen effects are unavailable through this language candidate until their own operative source review supplies the needed effect. Their dedicated questions are not prerequisites for authoring the ordinary language system. No rank, cost, duration or creature permission is invented here.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes: A player cannot cast pending Telepathy using Oracle Echo Voice's5-tile range or a borrowed external-game duration. A language guide can already explain that a lawful future telepathic channel will not automatically supply V, without first approving Telepathy.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Class, oath and source-specific communication
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: KEEP exact 48-card predicates; NEW narrowly named language interfaces
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
The accompanying CLASS_LANGUAGE_INTERFACE_REGISTER.json gives one disposition for every selected card (48), with its actual class file, ID and source hash, plus the actually consulted Heaven's Decree cross-reference. It changes no class acquisition, printed resource, duration, damage, save, target count, hard-control guard or review status. The following NEW completions belong to the language-facing candidate only; they do not promote these class cards.

1. Permanent Druidic knowledge uses LA-04's full ordinary mode convention. Keep automatic hidden-message recognition/meaning for an actual knower and the source DC15 noticing-only opportunity for a nonknower. A language can be secret socially without every plain sentence being a cipher; classify the actual inscription. Comprehend Languages does not discover an unseen message or bypass its own secret-cant/cipher/protected-meaning exclusions. The Druidic reference to magic is not permission to disregard the selected spell's limits. Keep actual form speech limits, Beast Spells and Archdruid component exceptions separate from language competence.

2. Oracle Tongues I grants receptive spoken-mortal comprehension, not speaking all mortal languages or universal literacy. Its +2 is limited to up to three hearing allies within25ft actually receiving relevant interpretation. NEW “Lore” completion for this interface: use one actual subject-appropriate knowledge skill (ordinarily INT/History for linguistic/history context; Arcana, Religion, Nature or Engineering only when that real subject governs). No new Lore proficiency, extra PB, Scribing Insight currency or blanket INT bonus is created. Insight remains the existing check, not codebreaking. “Fragmentary divine script,” mortal classification and genuine spirit access retain LA-16's setting boundary, without negating the source's literal grant.

3. KEEP speech-required Tongues boon activations, chorus suppression and their actual ranges/recipients. NEW minimal semantic completion is limited to Tongues III's one question/answer, Tongues IV's promised meaningful exchange, Tongues V's one bounded command, and Paladin Heaven's Decree's selected instruction: a legally reached target receives only the meaning necessary for that specified effect. This adds no general fluency, secrets, lasting language, extra question or other target. Do not add a shared-spoken-language eligibility requirement absent from those cards. Keep all expressly required hearing (including Tongues II/V and Heaven's Decree); Tongues III does not gain a new hearing gate absent from its target text, while the Oracle still must perform its speech-required activation. Unknowable questions remain unknown; player refusal and every anti-compulsion limit remain controlling. Truth-restricting Dominion auras do not gain this semantic bridge: they do not promise translation.

4. NEW Echo Voice telepathy completion: within the card's actual5-tile range, willing allies may exchange directed, intentional conceptual messages without a shared spoken language. Either participant can withhold a message or withdraw willingness. This conveys no involuntary thoughts, shared senses, third-party broadcast, speaker authentication, arbitrary written-language decoding, spell components or device protocol. Passive telepathy has no per-message1RC fee; its separate failed-roll reroll retains the actual Reaction/1RC cost and anti-recursion. Physical voice is unnecessary for this mental channel. No range, plane or line-of-effect exception beyond the real source/engine is added.

5. NEW Knowledge Transfer mode completion: the selected language conveys the donor's actual linguistic speaking/comprehension competence and only those read/write/script modes the donor actually possesses for that language, for the printed hour. It does not grant an otherwise unknown alphabet or transfer permanent possession of language, memories, secrets, Expertise or spellcasting. Temporary silence or an unspeaking form does not erase a donor's learned language; activation still must satisfy the actual feature. When the loan ends, retain learned particular information but remove its borrowed competencies. No donor transfer manufactures a complete curriculum or course-hours credit.

6. NEW Hush Descends acoustic completion, specific to `oracle.supplement.shadow.hush-descends`: ordinary sound does not transmit within or through the actual aura. Accordingly, creatures of either allegiance cannot receive ordinary audible communication over an affected sound path, and anyone lacking audible V cannot supply it without an actual exception. This is an explicit consequence of the completed acoustic field plus the existing V rule, not a silent extension of the hostile-only target list. Keep the card's express hostile speech/V prohibition and all other riders. The aura does not globally apply actor-condition Silenced, erase languages, prevent eligible mental/sign communication, or confer thunder immunity/damage cancellation. No shape, range, cost or duration changes. Public teaching must not turn this named scoped completion into the meaning of every “silence” title.

7. Oath Silence timing stays literal: Silent Smite checks since the END of the previous regular turn; Vow Unbroken checks since the BEGINNING. Do not normalize them. Intelligible vocal speech, V components and deliberate vocal commands count where the card defines them; involuntary sounds do not. NEW channel clarification: silent writing, rehearsed signs, purely mental messages and the player's accessible explanation are not vocal speaking. Deliberately performing the speaking/command/V act counts for such silence histories even if an external field prevents listeners hearing it; failed reception is not an exploit for a voluntary-silence rider. It does not count as a successful V component when audibility is absent.

8. Keep narrower permissions exactly. Aura of Stillness is noise attenuation and expressly permits speech/V; Quiet Step mutes movement, not conversation. Vow Absolute and Null Command Aura prohibit the selected targets' V as specified, not all ordinary speech; Hush, Silent Judgment and the relevant Death Touch/Null Command failure expressly bar speaking as well. Wordless Ward keeps its own no-V exception but not free resources or other component waivers. Crimson Agent Total Silence and Monk Deathless Silence do not inherit full Silenced from their titles. Wizard/Mage concentration defenses keep their actual damage-only scopes, and Shaman Balanced Elements does not extend silence.

A knowingly violated spoken prohibition requires actual target knowledge/comprehension of that prohibition; merely uttering an unknown language is not proof of knowing defiance. Preserve Obey Aura's bounded consequence rather than adding control. Dominion truthful-speech effects do not compel speech, prove every sincere claim true, or make every listener fluent. Preserve the exact oath conduct statements; do not broaden “speak when words serve the oath” into a new universal vow against interpretation, signs or player communication.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes:
An Oracle can understand an Aquan speaker under Tongues I and explain the actual message to a Common-speaking ally; the ally does not become Aquan-fluent. A Deafened ally cannot receive the boon’s hearing-dependent +2 through ordinary speech, even when eligible Echo Voice independently lets them exchange mental meaning.

A Silenced Oracle cannot start a speech-required Tongues boon merely by using telepathy. An actual passive Echo Voice can still function if its own prerequisites hold. A Vow Unbroken user who spoke during the preceding turn but not after that turn ended can satisfy Silent Smite's different window without satisfying Vow Unbroken.

Hush Descends does not secretly allow an allied V spell whose required audible speech cannot exist in the completed sound field. Conversely, Null Command Aura's explicit V-only restriction does not ban that enemy's ordinary spoken answer.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Eight pending feat comparisons
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: KEEP pending source conflicts and dedicated review boundaries
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
None of the eight compared feats is promoted by this conference, regardless of draft:false or needsReview:false in an original registry. Preserve full original names, prerequisite strings, effects and legacy conflicts.

Linguist (`linguist`) and Polyglot (`polyglot`) remain distinct three-language sources, not aliases or free existing character grants. Polyglot's related-dialect/script advantage does not teach an unknown language or decode its meaning. Prodigy (`prodigy`) retains its original ancestry eligibility and separate skill/tool/language/Expertise claims for dedicated review; no missing Half-Elf/Half-Orc equivalence is invented here.

Quick Learner (`quick_learner`) keeps its thirty-day/once-per-category operative wording and conflicting instant-lore description/legacy. Neither governs LA-06's NEW ordinary course and neither applies before its own review. Diligent Researcher (`diligent_researcher`) retains ordinary research timing and explicit language/access/material boundaries; it is not an authorized discount on fluency, a completed Scribing Insight-spend procedure, protected archives or a task reclassified after work.

Cold Reader (`cold_reader`) remains routed to the existing SF-05 question in SKILL_FEAT_SOURCE_PREPARATION.json. Its observation/speech/evidence/Insight-versus-Deception questions do not become actual telepathy, translation or automatic motive truth. The other seven exact feat IDs are already preserved in the supplied language comparison/full feat evidence; where that packet supplies no dedicated question number, retain their actual IDs rather than inventing a review receipt. Existing related Runic Scholar, Spell Scribe, Silent Casting and Still Casting queues are not approved by a language interface. Source-specific future changes may revise their own interface without reopening this entire ordinary language conference.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes: A character with an unapproved Quick Learner selection cannot complete a language by waiting30calendar days under this verdict. A future approved research feat must meet its own actual task predicate; calling a fluency course “research” does not reduce its hours automatically.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Completed Scribing, rune and device interfaces
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: KEEP fulfilled advanced procedures; no new currency or recipe review
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
The advanced-crafting gate remains fulfilled. This language candidate adopts the actual current nineteen applicable procedure sections and forty Scribing card records, not obsolete preparation labels or the source verdict before its exact corrections.

SC-03: a properly encoded script provides temporary repertoire for that one activation only to an otherwise qualified real caster. The user must actually read/understand the encoded instructions and satisfy the fixed class/rank/school, components, hand/access, RP and casting-time rules. Owning the scroll, recognizing its alphabet, receiving a secondhand assurance or understanding literal words is not proof of a readable functional payload. A qualifying comprehension effect can satisfy only the actual ordinary-language part of the access test; it supplies no excluded magical glyph function or missing spell eligibility. Do not impose SC-05's consultation minute on SC-03 activation as an extra invented casting tax.

SC-04/05 and AEX-07: keep actual relevant content and genuine necessary lead consultation (at least one minute, or the whole genuinely shorter task), actual availability/function and the source's self-production exclusion. Copying a book makes an actual information copy, not a new set of magic, charges, Insight awards or reading competence. A translated guide can carry genuinely translated content, but translation does not transfer another physical item's bonus or refresh its ledger.

SC-07/08: languages:0 remains zero on recipe-476,486,672, not absent or one. Recipe-498/500 can grant one Language Insight only from actually useful parallel text after one active study hour. Points belong to the researcher and target language, maximum six unspent. The same underlying evidence/correspondence awards once per reader across copies, holders, editions and magical recreations. Saturation creates no deferred credit. The private recipe-674 retains its exact three-point and cross-disciplinary procedures internally, not a public extra method.

Spend three points for that target language plus eight active hours to translate one preregistered, genuinely supported, accessible/legible passage of at most250words. Keep the existing no-extra-check supported-translation procedure: missing meaning/evidence makes it unqualified before spending. It grants no fluency, second cipher solution, new hidden meaning, formula or spell knowledge. No universal “Insight-to-language” exchange is added. The hour gaining Insight, the eight hours spending it, an ordinary decipher project, a fluency/literacy course and formula work cannot claim the same work. A real translation may later become useful evidence/curriculum content, but completed past hours receive no retroactive second award.

Recipe-675's exact personal comprehension/consent of the entire actual bargain remains required in its private procedure. An interpreter's unexplained assurance is not the signatory's comprehension. Neither this statement nor an ordinary language guide publishes the private item, its membership, terms or hidden annotations. Completed fixed source meaning, public spell access and ordinary legal/fictional consent remain separate.

RC-01/02: Runic language literacy and Runecarver's-tools proficiency are not interchangeable. Knowing Runic neither grants a Rune Carving credential nor identifies magical glyph function or authorizes arm/disarm. Keep actual finite inspection/disarm methods, DC, hand/tool/access and failure triggers; a rune is not guaranteed to activate merely because a translation roll fails. RC-07's ten-uninterrupted-minute ward attunement and actual Reaction/charge timing remain independent of language unless a particular real source says otherwise. No charged rune is refilled by being read or recited.

TI-04: preserve actual controller binding, capability/INT6+, ten active minutes with actual Tinker's tools, legitimate accessible interface, 60ft visible/audible control communication, Bonus Action timing and the shared one-command/one-offensive-output budget. A valid channel carries the already authorized device protocol; language fluency is not controller authority or knowledge of an unknown protocol. Seeing/hearing a command does not mean any capable creature can issue it. An interpreter or telepathic ally is not an undocumented hardware adapter. A visible authorized signal may work where it is actually the configured channel; ordinary telepathy cannot silently replace an unspecified device receiver.

Keep device service clocks and actual restoration separate from language learning, reprogramming, interpretation, rest and controller transfer. Preserve the distinct class/crafted-device membership. TD-08 still moves at most two CURRENT Dissonance into ONE own active qualifying device within30ft under its actual Bonus Action/frequency; it is not a language channel, three recipients or a charge reset. TI-08's private relay limits and the literal Silent Ones/Heartcell exclusion remain unchanged even if a language/access flag says permitted.

Public authoring may explain the public recipe-500 Insight procedure and public language-zero/consultation interfaces. Do not publish recipe-498,674,675,686 or private membership/dossiers merely because an internal language analysis names them. Their full literal records stay internal.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes:
A researcher with two Insight earns one from new qualifying public500 evidence in one actual hour, then spends three and eight more hours on one supported200-word passage. That is nine actual hours, not nine course hours, and not a new fluent language. Re-reading a second copy of the same correspondence grants no new point.

A Deafened controller cannot receive an audible-only lesson, but may issue a preconfigured visible device command if the actual controller/channel requirements are satisfied. Learning Common never enables an otherwise unauthorized construct to accept commands. Repair or service does not reset a prior translation/Insight history.

exactReviewClarifications.text: **LAX-03 exact scope correction:** the ordinary TI-04 binding, command and attached-phase fields apply to its controlled automata, and to a special profile only through that profile's explicit invocation. They are not default procedures for every crafted device. Combat commands use the actual regular-turn Bonus Action and shared allowances. decisionApplicationRegister.title: Records, provenance and eventual companion parity
decisionApplicationRegister.disposition: NEW candidate schema; preserve existing arrays and saves
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
Author a separate versioned language interface, not an in-place rewrite of the originals. Preserve source spelling, exact field presence/null/value, source path/hash/record ID and every actual grant. Canonical keys are language identities, not physical voices, script IDs, currencies or source text.

Required records:
• Competency: canonical language ID; source spelling(s); dialect/register qualifier; exact granted modes; script/orthography relations with evidence; permanent versus temporary; all grant provenance.
• Choice: original grant/slot, count and actual allowed alternatives/restriction; prior fixed competencies; selected identity/modes; eligibility premise; resolution time; invalid/exhausted status without fabricated replacement.
• Temporary effect: actual source/card/caster/recipient, allowed modes or bounded message/passage, consent, range/channel, actual start/end/suppression and costs. Keep actual resource/condition histories elsewhere linked, not recreated by language knowledge.
• Learning: course/module identity, tutor/curriculum and modes, real materials/access, chronological active intervals and complete-phase credit, source-specific losses, fees, interruptions, final completion and provenance. Prevent overlapping time claims.
• Text/evidence: physical text and content/version identity, supported language/script/actual passage, word extent, accessible representation, translation provenance and parent correspondence. A copy gets its own physical ID but shares underlying evidence identity.
• Scribing ledger: researcher plus target language, current0–6 Insight, once-per-reader evidence receipts, actual gain/spend events and passage. This is not a skill proficiency or generic character XP.
• Communication event: sender, intended recipients, actual channel, specific content/meaning evidence, delivery/interpretation/receipt order, actual time and capacity. Do not certify private knowledge from a caller-supplied “understood” boolean alone.

Normalize only LA-02's explicit aliases in a derived view. Do not strip literal source strings or convert unknown/absent fields to favorable values. Preserve null, empty and absent separately. No entry grants a spell, class or feat because a name matches. A conditional capability must be reevaluated from its actual current source and physical state.

The two source runtime arrays remain preserved alternatives. Human/Undead abbreviated arrays omit their actual choice slots; the Mycelian fixed label conflicts with the full regional choice. The authored candidate must display the actual slots and require an actual evidenced selection for an old ambiguous save. Never auto-select Mycelic, retroactively erase a prior valid language, charge a course to a valid starting grant or treat a malformed save as secret access. Runtime migration and implementation require their own explicit, version-bound change; this source conference performs neither.

Construct the public guide/record schema from an allowlist of operational ordinary rules, public literal grants and admitted public identity labels. Keep private membership, hidden dossiers, deferred lore definitions and particular character secrets out of public examples. The internal register can preserve them without treating every discoverable source ID as player-visible.
decisionApplicationRegister.workedBoundaryOutcomes: An old Mycelian save containing only Common/Mycelian is marked for resolving the missing actual regional choice, retaining its old bytes. It is not silently upgraded to Common/Mycelic. Two physical copies of a bilingual page have different inventory IDs but the same underlying-evidence key for each researcher's Insight anti-repeat record.

decisionApplicationRegister.title: Deferred language/setting receipts
decisionApplicationRegister.authoringWording:
Preserve the chapter's literal names, language restrictions and source paragraphs exactly. This record neither interprets their origins nor supplies deep-language content, attunement, transmission, cosmological taxonomy or new access.

Exact deferred questions:
1. The Voice, source line5673: what actual controlling source establishes a being's stated attunement to Calan’thir’s vibration, the extent/mode of understanding and an authorized acquisition route? Preserve The First Voice, the Speaker and Archons as literal examples, without defining them.
2. Resonant Cant, line5674: what source defines the meaningful architectural/frequency evidence, what “decipherable by Mirrorsages, Tinkers, or beings with exposure to the Source” permits, and the actual exposure/deciphering predicate? It is not an automatic class language or free result from a title.
3. Deep Cant, Deep Speech and Murkish: what explicit source, if any, establishes a relationship or transferable meaning? Until such a source is reviewed, their identities stay distinct. Existing explicitly named starting grants are not revoked.
4. Forgotten Script and Runic: what particular historical written traditions and actual protected passages are meant where that distinction matters? Ordinary attested written competency is authorized above; neither label decodes every ancient language, magical rune or hidden annotation.
5. Oracle “spoken mortal languages,” “fragmentary divine script,” and willing-spirit communication: which actual source defines the affected category and the finite information present? 7. Private Scribing/relay records: what later authorized source gives any latent Matrix annotation its actual meaning? Preserve every Silent Ones/Heartcell exclusion and hidden metadata literally; language understanding, a controller permission or Insight cannot waive them.
8. Unlisted/discovered languages: which actual private record supplies the specific name, restriction, mode and meaningful evidence for a proposed future operation? Do not enumerate private membership in a public choice list or invent a language because the chapter says others exist.

These are bounded later receipts, not prerequisites for finishing the ordinary language candidate. An actually unsupported protected-language operation remains unavailable; it does not hold every ordinary communication, starting grant or course hostage. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier) or take 1d4 fire damage. This damage increases to 2d4 at 6th level, 3d4 at 11th level, and 4d4 at 16th level. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Scavenger's Luck

traits.name: Improvised Tool
traits.text:
As an action, you can create a simple tool or weapon from available materials. You create one of the following items, which lasts until you use this trait again:
A simple weapon
A set of thieves' tools
A climber's kit
A healing kit
Any other simple tool the Director agrees to
The item functions as a normal item of its kind but has half the normal hit points. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Shadow Blend

traits.name: Wayfinder

Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Hallucinogenic Cloud
traits.text: When you use your Spore Cloud trait, you can choose to release hallucinogenic spores instead of blinding spores. Creatures that fail the saving throw experience mild hallucinations and have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Spore Preservation
traits.text: You can preserve a small sample of your spores in a special container. If you die, these spores can potentially grow into a new mycelian with your memories and personality, effectively reincarnating you. This process requires specific conditions and is not guaranteed to succeed.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase

Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Consume Decay
traits.text: When you are adjacent to a corpse or significant amount of decaying organic matter, you can use your action to absorb nutrients from it. You gain temporary hit points equal to your level that last for 1 hour. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Decay Sense
traits.text: You can sense the presence of dead or decaying organic matter within 30 feet of you. You also know the general age of the decay.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase

traits.name: Symbiotic Bond
traits.text: As an action, you can form a temporary bond with a willing creature you can touch. This bond lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Empathic Link
traits.text: While you are bonded to a creature using your Symbiotic Bond trait, you can sense the creature's emotions and general physical condition (healthy, injured, diseased, etc.) as long as you are on the same plane of existence.

fullCurrentBackgroundRecord.name: Aethel City Guard Veteran

source.text: Skill Proficiencies: Athletics, Insight
Tool Proficiencies: One type of gaming set, Vehicles (Land)
Equipment: A piece of your old uniform (e.g., a dented helmet or worn insignia), a map of Aethel's main districts, a set of common clothes, manacles, and a belt pouch containing 10 gp.

You gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to spot trouble within city limits and on checks made to navigate or find locations within Aethel. Your time in the Guard grants you Neutral starting Reputation with Aethel authorities and Liked starting Reputation among the city's common folk.

You also know how to navigate guild bureaucracy or find contacts within the artisan community, though your departure means you have Disliked starting Reputation with your former guild but Neutral starting Reputation with rival guilds or independent artisans.

fullCurrentBackgroundRecord.name: Seeker of the Lost Pantheon

source.text: Skill Proficiencies: Religion, History
Tool Proficiencies: Calligrapher's supplies or Cartographer's tools (choose one)
Languages: Two of your choice (often ancient or obscure ones)
Equipment: A rubbing from an ancient tablet, a book of fragmented myths, a holy symbol of a forgotten deity (perhaps self-made), a set of common clothes, incense, and 10 gp.

Feature: Whispers of the Past: Your research into forgotten lore gives you occasional insights. When encountering ancient ruins, symbols, or texts related to Aethel's history (pre-dating the current dominant faiths), you have advantage on Intelligence checks (History, Religion, Arcana) to decipher their meaning or context. Your quest grants you Neutral starting Reputation with mainstream religious orders (who may view you with suspicion) but Liked starting Reputation with fringe historians, hidden cults, or communities that secretly maintain old traditions.

fullCurrentBackgroundRecord.name: Marked Fugitive

source.text: Skill Proficiencies: Stealth, Arcana
Tool Proficiencies: Thieves' Tools
Languages: One obscure or factional language (e.g., Celestial, Infernal, Forgotten Script)
Equipment: Broken manacle, false identity papers, hidden mark or scar, 10 gp in mixed coin

Feature: Echo of the Stolen: You carry a fragment of forbidden power. Once per long rest, you may replicate a 1st-level spell you've seen cast (must have been cast within the last hour, and you must have line of sight when it was cast). It uses your Charisma and can only be used if it fits your class spell list or mystery. After using this, your brand glows faintly, potentially alerting your pursuers. This power grants you Liked starting Reputation with underground resistance movements but Hated starting Reputation with the faction you stole from.

Your professional reputation grants you Liked starting Reputation with merchant guilds and explorers' societies but Neutral starting Reputation with indigenous tribes wary of outsiders mapping their territories.

Druidic
You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak the language and use it to leave hidden messages. You and others who know this language automatically spot such a message. Beast Spells
Beginning at 18th level, you can cast many of your druid spells in any shape you assume using Shapeshifting. You can perform the somatic and verbal components of a druid spell while in a beast shape, but you aren't able to provide material components.

Archdruid
At 20th level, you can use your Shapeshifting feature an unlimited number of times.
